classification.category: mobile-first web game / customizable game package
classification.duplicate_merge_decision: Canonical candidate; EVENTo0/saeed-game must be migrated/archived before sale.

product.value_proposition: Arabic-first mobile browser survival/action game that can be branded and deployed without an app-store dependency.

deployment.release_path: npm build → smoke/unit verification → preview → customer production host.

support_boundary.default_delivery_model: Build → Customize → Deploy → Handoff → Customer Owns & Operates

p0: Unresolved duplicate source: EVENTo0/saeed-game remains a competing Saeed game repository and has not been formally migrated/archived.
p1: Current README claims 87 unit tests and 64 browser checks but release evidence is not linked to a current CI run in this audit.
Commercial license register/SKU/sales handoff pack is missing.
Customer branding/config boundary is not documented as a reusable template.

evidence.note: Live demo documented by the current repository README.
Documents static deployment and reported test commands/counts.

decision.reason: Technically close, but Merge Before Build blocks sale until the duplicate Saeed repository is resolved and commercial handoff evidence is packaged.
decision.next_action: Make Game-1-Saeed-octa the sole canonical source by migrating any unique saeed-game assets and marking the legacy repository read-only/archive-ready.
